evidence: "# ---------- greedy trial ----------" and the statement's "If multiple valid assignments exist, any of them will be accepted."
affordance_in_statement: If multiple valid assignments exist, any of them will be accepted.
removal_suggestion: Require the submitted assignment to be a canonical valid assignment determined from the input, rather than accepting any valid assignment; present the canonicalization as part of the scenario's official scheduling policy.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: It first attempts a degree-ordered greedy coloring and can return any valid 3-coloring found.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: If multiple valid assignments exist, any of them will be accepted.

common_affordance: If multiple valid assignments exist, any of them will be accepted.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It uses straightforward recursive backtracking in vertex order, causing exponential search and TLE on difficult 3-coloring instances.
It likewise attempts plain recursive 3-coloring with local safety checks and lacks effective variable ordering or pruning, leading to TLE.

recommended_edit: Replace the arbitrary-witness sentence with a requirement for a canonical valid schedule derived from the input, so a fast greedy witness is no longer sufficient and the solver must also perform the canonical optimization.
regression_risk: This could make the already-defeated recursive solvers fail even earlier, but is unlikely to restore either defeated implementation.
